view.description:
"player" (the record on its platter) | "mini".

Takes "player" or "mini". Default: "player".

sidebar.description:
The sidebar out, and which of its panels: "queue" | "library" | "data".

Takes true or false. Default: false.

remember.description:
true: the first open of a session is the three above, and after that the popup comes back as you left it. false: every open is
the three above.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

sort.description:
How each grouping is sorted: albums by "artist" | "title" | "year" | "length" | "songs"; artists and genres by "name" | "albums" |
"songs" | "length"; playlists by "order" | "name" | "songs".

ascending.description:
false: every sort from its far end (the newest year first).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

looseArtists.description:
Artists who have loose songs only are listed too.

Takes true or false. Default: false.

library.description: The library as the popup opens it.

autoplay.description:
Something put in an empty queue starts to play by itself.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

holdForRecord.description:
A play waits until the record has come down on the platter.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

prevRestartSec.description:
"Previous" this many seconds into a song goes back to its start instead of to the song before. 0: always the song before. 0 .. 60.

Takes a number 0 .. 60. Default: 3.

musicSparks.description:
The viewfinder's sparks follow the music (one process and about 25 MB while the popup is open and a song plays).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

shuffle.description: Shuffle: the least songs between two of one artist, and between two of one album. 0 .. 20.

music.description:
mpd's music directory.

Takes a path. Default: "~/Music". Read as the shell starts.

albums.description:
Its folders: albums (artist / album), loose songs, playlists, and the playlist that is the favourites.

Takes a text. Default: "Albums". Read as the shell starts.

tracks.description: Takes a text. Default: "Tracks". Read as the shell starts.

playlists.description: Takes a text. Default: "Playlists". Read as the shell starts.

favorites.description: Takes a text. Default: "Favorites". Read as the shell starts.

covers.description:
The cover's file names, the first that is there.

Takes a list of texts. Default: ["cover.jpg","cover.png","cover.webp"]. Read as the shell starts.

socket.description:
mpd's socket (a local one: no host and port). "": $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/mpd/socket.

Takes a path. Default: "". Read as the shell starts.

paths.description: Where the music is. Read as the shell starts.
